readme.markdown:
# demo.st

Demo stage for vibe-coded prototypes. Reserve a subdomain, publish from your agent via MCP, get a clean link like **yourproject.demo.st**. Static hosting only (Nginx; no PHP, no databases).

- **Site:** [https://demo.st](https://demo.st)
- **MCP endpoint:** [https://demo.st/mcp](https://demo.st/mcp)

## Cursor plugin

This repo is a [Cursor plugin](https://cursor.com/docs/plugins). Install it from the [Cursor Marketplace](https://cursor.com/marketplace) (after it’s published) or add the repo in Cursor to use the demo.st MCP server.

### Getting your MCP token

Authenticated tools (reserve subdomain, upload zip, clear, release) require a Bearer token:

1. Sign in at [https://demo.st](https://demo.st) (create an account if needed).
2. Open [https://demo.st/api/mcp/token](https://demo.st/api/mcp/token) or the [MCP page](https://demo.st/mcp) and copy the token.
3. Set it as an environment variable:
   - **Windows (PowerShell):** `$env:DEMO_ST_MCP_TOKEN = "your-token-here"`
   - **macOS / Linux:** `export DEMO_ST_MCP_TOKEN="your-token-here"`
   - Or add to your shell profile (`.bashrc`, `.zshrc`) so Cursor picks it up.
4. Restart Cursor (or reload the window). The Agent can then use demo.st tools.

### MCP tools

- `check_subdomain_availability` — Check if a subdomain is available (no token).
- `reserve_subdomain` — Reserve a subdomain (token required).
- `upload_site` — Upload a .zip as site content; use `zip_base64` (easiest for agents) or `file_url` for a public zip URL (token required).
- `clear_site` — Remove deployed content; subdomain stays reserved (token required).
- `release_subdomain` — Release your subdomain (token required).

toolsPreview.name: check_subdomain_availability
toolsPreview.description: Check if a subdomain name is available on demo.st (e.g. "my-site" → my-site.demo.st).

toolsPreview.name: reserve_subdomain
toolsPreview.description: Reserve a subdomain for the logged-in account. One subdomain per account.

toolsPreview.name: upload_site
toolsPreview.description: Upload a .zip as site content for your reserved subdomain. Easiest for agents: zip_base64 (base64-encoded zip). Or file_url (public URL to zip). Or file_path (local path, when MCP runs locally).

toolsPreview.name: clear_site
toolsPreview.description: Remove deployed site content from your subdomain. Subdomain remains reserved.

toolsPreview.name: release_subdomain
toolsPreview.description: Release your reserved subdomain. Deletes the reservation, any deployed site, and all document DB data for that site.

toolsPreview.name: get_site_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Get (or create) the public site API key for your reserved subdomain. Embed this key in your static site and call https://api.demo.st/v1 with Authorization: Bearer <key>. Tenant is scoped by the key — never share another site's key.

toolsPreview.name: rotate_site_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Rotate the public site API key. The old key stops working immediately; update your site with the new key.

toolsPreview.name: list_collections
toolsPreview.description: List document collections for your site (api.demo.st document store).

toolsPreview.name: create_collection
toolsPreview.description: Create a document collection (lowercase letter start; letters, numbers, underscores; max 63 chars). Max 20 collections per site.

toolsPreview.name: delete_collection
toolsPreview.description: Delete a document collection and all of its records.

toolsPreview.name: list_records
toolsPreview.description: List records in a document collection.

toolsPreview.name: upsert_record
toolsPreview.description: Create or update a JSON record in a collection. Pass data as an object. Optional id to upsert a specific record.

toolsPreview.name: delete_record
toolsPreview.description: Delete a record from a document collection.
